design_basis.source: M8B frozen 18 extra-entry trade exploratory audit
design_basis.reason_for_minimalism: User objective prioritizes robust after-cost edge, high win rate and useful frequency; do not collapse frequency by stacking strict thresholds.
design_basis.causality_correction: FINALIZED EXTRA classification is only known after source-arrival grace. Therefore no gate decision may depend on classification==EXTRA_CANDIDATE at entry time.

SOURCE_ANCHOR.description: Supported Mochipoyo source alerts remain a separate anchor branch and are not suppressed by this proxy-branch gate.

CONTROL_PROXY.description: Accept every future proxy PRIMARY_LONG/PRIMARY_SHORT candidate at its decision time, before any later source-match classification.

CHALLENGER_PROXY_BLOCK_BTCUSD_LONG.description: At proxy decision time, reject BTCUSD PRIMARY_LONG candidates and accept all other proxy PRIMARY entries. This decision does not use future source-match or outcome information.
CHALLENGER_PROXY_BLOCK_BTCUSD_LONG.source_anchor_policy: SOURCE_ANCHOR remains independent and may later provide a source alert even when the proxy branch was rejected.

later_attribution_only_not_gate_input.source_match_classification: After grace expiry, future candidates may be attributed as SOURCE_MATCHED or EXTRA for analysis/deduplication only.

why_not: Those dimensions would add degrees of freedom on only 18 outcome trades and risk overfitting or frequency collapse.
